Consider increasing NUM_SPLITS to 8 to raise SM occupancy on the 4090 (128 SM tiles for M=1024 are few), and have each split write a single (max, sum) per row tile rather than per row to reduce partial-buffer traffic.

- Apply the fused LeakyReLU(0.0001 effective slope) + double-GELU in the final-store epilogue of whichever kernel produces the per-row logsumexp, so the M-length vector is never re-read.
